description: This file defines a React component 'TransactionForm' that allows users to input and add financial transactions (income or expense) to the budget data. It includes form fields for transaction type, amount, description, and category, and handles form submission to update the budget data state. It leverages a custom hook 'useBudgetData' for data management.

methods.name: TransactionForm
methods.description: React functional component for transaction input form with validation and submission handling.
